title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Monday, 21 September 2026
description: Today: Trump announces a new 'AI Force' and AI czar as Alibaba's Qwen ships a new omnimodal model and a Beijing AI startup passes a billion-dollar valuation; Albanese launches Australia's UN Security Council campaign built around cyber safety; Queensland's Taskforce Yankee Tread charges 81 people over 265 dangerous-driving offences; and the Gold Coast approves a $1.5 million illegal camping crackdown. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
